title: Sky Swarm
description: A sky full of bugs and they're all heading your way. Your guns fire on their own, so just fly well. Chilis power up your shots, donuts give you a shield, cherries give you a spare ship. Every fifth wave, something big shows up. Bring a co-pilot if you like.
instructions: Player 1: WASD. Player 2: arrow keys. Solo pilots can use either. On a phone, drag anywhere to fly. Co-op scores don't go on the leaderboard.
